_doc: Seed for the Joplin SDK's offline test mode. Handed to JoplinSDK.test() as
{entity: {note: {<id>: <record>}}}; the SDK stamps the map key onto the
record's own id field, which for every entity of all four sources derives
to `id` - established by running each SDK's resolver, not by reading routes.
Timestamps are Joplin's own form: epoch milliseconds, integers. Fixed and
frozen: an entry that asserted on the wall clock would pass for one second
